title: Forms
intro: Build a form, share its link, and read every response here.
loadFailed: Could not load forms. Check the Firestore rules are deployed.

empty.title: No forms yet
empty.text: Create one from the Komitmen Pelaksanaan Tadarus template or start blank.

create.title: New form
create.linkHint: Letters, numbers and dashes. This cannot be changed later.

errors.badLink: The link needs 3–60 letters, numbers or dashes.
errors.taken: /form/{{id}} is already used. Pick another link.
errors.failed: Could not create the form. Check your connection and try again.

komitmen-tadarus.title: Komitmen Pelaksanaan Tadarus
komitmen-tadarus.description: Duta Qur'an participant details and their Tadarus plan in Indonesia.

hint.open: Anyone with the link can answer.
hint.closed: The link shows the form is closed.

status.failed: Could not change the status. Try again.

detail.notFoundText: /form/{{id}} does not exist, or it was deleted.

builder.formLanguageHint: The language people see first when they open the link. They can still switch.
builder.question: Question
builder.placeholder: Example answer shown in the empty box (optional)
builder.deletedNote: Answers already collected for a deleted question stay in the CSV export.
builder.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

problems.duplicateOption: Question {{n}} has the same option twice.

builder.branch: Go to section based on answer
builder.reorderHint: Drag, or use the arrows. Check the "After section" rules again after reordering.
builder.fileNote: Files go to the private Markaz Tadarus Forms Shared Drive, in a folder for each response. People don't need a Google account.

cover.hint: Shown across the top of the form instead of the green banner. A wide photo works best.

errors.unreadable: This file could not be opened as an image. Try a JPG or PNG.
errors.tooLarge: This image is too large even after shrinking. Try a smaller one.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save the cover. Check your connection and try again.
errors.removeFailed: Could not remove the cover. Try again.
errors.moveFailed: Could not change the position. Try again.

responses.emptyOpen: Share the link from the Share tab — answers appear here live.
responses.emptyClosed: Open the form (top right) and share its link to start collecting answers.
responses.deleteText: This response will be removed permanently.
responses.reportFailed: The report could not be made. Try again.

share.draftTitle: This form is still a draft
share.draftText: People who open the link will see “form not found” until you open it.
share.closedText: People who open the link are told it no longer accepts answers.
share.shortLink: Want a shorter link? Create one in the Redirect Manager pointing to this form.
share.deleteText: Removes the form and every response. This cannot be undone — export the CSV first.
share.deleteFailed: Could not delete the form. Try again.
share.message:
Assalamu'alaikum.

Please take a moment to fill in the form *{{title}}* using this link:
{{link}}

Jazakumullahu khairan.

public.notFoundText: This link may be wrong, or the form has not been opened yet. Please contact whoever sent you the link.
public.closedText: This form is no longer accepting answers. Thank you for your interest.
public.thanksText: Your answer has been received. Jazakumullahu khairan.
public.preview: Preview for admins — this form is {{status}}, so answers cannot be sent.
public.closedError: This form is closed. Your answer could not be sent.
public.sendError: Could not send. Check your internet connection and try again.

errors.phone: This WhatsApp number is not valid.
errors.fileType: That type of file is not accepted here.
errors.fileCount: You can add up to {{count}} files.

quiz.later: Your answers are recorded. Your score will be shared after review.

download.title: Download a copy of your answers
download.hint: Save it as a PDF, or as PNG to share (on a WhatsApp status, for example).
download.failed: The file could not be made. Try again.

public.uploading: Sending your files… {{percent}}%. Please keep this page open.
public.uploadError: Your files could not be sent. Check your connection and try again; your answers are still here.

print.title: Print this response
print.intro: Tick the sections to print; open the arrow to choose their questions. Each section prints on its own page under the Markaz Tadarus letterhead.
print.failed: The PDF could not be made. Use Print and choose "Save as PDF".

quiz.makeHint: Assign point values, set answers, and show results automatically.
quiz.releaseNowHint: People see their score right away. The answer key travels to their browser, so use this for practice, not for serious exams.
quiz.releaseLaterHint: The answer key stays with the admins. Scores show in the Responses tab.
quiz.missedHint: People see which questions were answered incorrectly.
quiz.correctHint: People see the correct answers once grades are released.
quiz.pointsHint: People see the points of each question and their total.
quiz.acceptedHint: Type and press Enter; capitals do not matter
quiz.tapCorrect: Tap a circle or box to mark the correct answer
quiz.byHand: Graded by hand in the Responses tab

settings.downloadHint: After sending, people get PDF and PNG download buttons with their answers on the Markaz Tadarus letterhead (a Kartu Tadarus, for example).

list.duplicateText: Makes a copy of "{{title}}": its questions, sections, settings, cover and answer key. Responses are not copied; the copy starts as a draft.

stats.rightRateNote: Questions with a low share may need explaining again.
